description: Validate a UBL Invoice or CreditNote against the official PINT AE 1.0.4 Schematron (shared PINT rules + UAE rules) published by OpenPeppol. Returns failed rule IDs, messages and XPath locations. First call downloads and compiles the rules (~5 s); later calls take milliseconds. Does not perform XSD schema or signature validation.

path.description: Path to an XML file (alternative to xml)

name: validate_pint_ae_xml
